title: Syria interim president accuses Israel of fighting ‘ghosts’ and exporting crises
summary: Ahmed al-Sharaa says Israel justifies aggression in the name of security amid airstrikes on southern Syria Syria’s interim president has accused Israel of fighting “ghosts” and exporting its crises to other countries after the war in Gaza. President Ahmed al-Sharaa’s comments come amid persistent airstrikes and incursions by the Israeli military into southern Syria. Continue reading...
